in_sanskrit.name: योगमयी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is full of yoga or union with the divine.

in_marathi.name: Yogmayi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Union of Yoga and Illusion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yogmayi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yogmayi represents the union of yoga (spiritual practice) and maya (illusion) in Hinduism.

in_bengali.name: Yogmayi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Union of Yoga and Illusion
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yogmayi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Yogmayi represents the union of yoga (spiritual practice) and maya (illusion) in Hinduism.
